notes.title: Update notes for Dec 21
notes.content: - Made changes to the games saving system to try and help prevent save file loss

notes.title: 1.2 Progress Loss Prevention Patch
notes.content:
- Added an Autosave feature which runs every 5 minutes
- Greatly sped up saving speeds
- You can now resize the game window
- Fixed an issue with the rebirth multiplier not being applied correctly despite the multiplier showing the correct value
- Added UI to display the price of the next dino

We appreciate all your support and feedback so far!

notes.title: 1.1 Hotfix Changes
notes.content:
We've heard your feedback and have released some important changes in this hotfix to allow the game to run in the background and to hopefully fix the rebirth bug where prices were not resetting.

Thank you for playing the game and giving us feedback!
